title: LDC draft: what changed between 11:42 and 14:31
standfirst: Selected changes clarify the Convention reference, revise support terminology and institutional references, and remove explicit “for adoption” wording from provisions concerning November 2027 recommendations.
reporting_note: AI-generated pilot drafted from selected public UNFCCC PDF excerpts in a fresh context and checked against the source passages by a separate AI reviewer. No human editorial approval. This is not an autonomous monitoring-to-publication pipeline.

blocks.heading: COP preamble
blocks.md:
The COP preamble replaces recognition of LDC needs with a fuller reference to Article 4.9, recalling that Parties shall take full account of those needs regarding funding and technology transfer.

[Reviewed baseline, p. 1](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000350/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA8.pdf#page=1) · [Revised draft, p. 1](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000354/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA81.pdf#page=1)

blocks.heading: COP paragraph 8
blocks.md:
The COP draft replaces “technical guidance” with “technical assistance” in the national adaptation plan implementation-platform provision.

[Reviewed baseline, p. 2](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000350/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA8.pdf#page=2) · [Revised draft, p. 2](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000354/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA81.pdf#page=2)

blocks.heading: COP paragraphs 10 and 21
blocks.md:
COP paragraph 10 explicitly identifies implementing agencies of the Least Developed Countries Fund. Paragraph 21 replaces forwarding “those recommendations” “for adoption” with forwarding “a recommendation” to COP’s November 2027 session.

[Reviewed baseline, p. 3](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000350/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA8.pdf#page=3) · [Revised draft, p. 3](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000354/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA81.pdf#page=3) · [Baseline paragraph 21, p. 4](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000350/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA8.pdf#page=4) · [Revised paragraph 21, p. 4](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000354/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA81.pdf#page=4)

blocks.heading: CMA paragraph 9
blocks.md:
CMA paragraph 9 explicitly identifies implementing agencies of the Least Developed Countries Fund, revising the earlier grouping with accredited entities and implementing agencies.

[Reviewed baseline, p. 7](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000350/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA8.pdf#page=7) · [Revised draft, p. 7](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000354/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA81.pdf#page=7)

blocks.heading: CMA paragraph 20
blocks.md:
CMA paragraph 20 replaces forwarding “those recommendations” “for adoption” with forwarding “a recommendation” to CMA’s November 2027 session.

[Reviewed baseline, p. 8](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000350/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA8.pdf#page=8) · [Revised draft, p. 8](https://docs.unfccc.int/documents/10000354/files/en/LDCs_DT_COP31_CMA81.pdf#page=8)

blocks.heading: Why it matters
blocks.md: Removing “for adoption” makes the stated procedural destination less explicit about the intended decision outcome; it does not establish what Parties will decide.

blocks.heading: What to watch
blocks.md: Check whether subsequent drafts retain the revised recommendation wording.

blocks.heading: Scope and version limits
blocks.md:
Both texts are drafts; comparison does not establish consensus, adoption or political intent.

Only this pair and supplied excerpts were considered. Selected changes are not exhaustive.
